name: ai-coding-pipeline
description: Web AI Coding Pipeline - MRD to Code Workbench

scripts.test: npm run build && DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql:///ai_coding_test} DATABASE_SSL=false AI_CODING_PROFILE=local AI_CODING_STORAGE_DRIVER=file AI_CODING_EVENT_BUS=memory AI_CODING_ARTIFACT_STORE=local node --test dist/__tests__/*.test.js
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && AI_CODING_PROFILE=local AI_CODING_STORAGE_DRIVER=file AI_CODING_EVENT_BUS=memory AI_CODING_ARTIFACT_STORE=local node --test dist/__tests__/*.test.js
scripts.test:production-without-demo: npm run build && NODE_ENV=test AI_CODING_ALLOW_INSECURE_TEST_INFRA=1 RUN_PRODUCTION_WITHOUT_DEMO_E2E=1 node --test dist/__tests__/*.test.js
scripts.storage:migrate: npm run build && node dist/storage/migration/cli.js migrate
scripts.storage:verify: npm run build && node dist/storage/migration/cli.js verify
scripts.storage:export: npm run build && node dist/storage/migration/cli.js export
scripts.storage:load-test: npm run build && DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql:///ai_coding_test} DATABASE_SSL=false node dist/storage/loadTest.js
